text:
If you’ve got a walk, ride, or errands to knock out, today is a good one to do it. Burlington is clear and crisp at 39 this morning, with full sunshine pushing the afternoon to a high right around 58. It’ll feel cooler again after sunset, which comes just before 6, and the sky stays clear tonight as temperatures fall to around 34.

Tomorrow keeps the same quiet pattern, sunny with a high near 56 and another chilly start. The forecasters’ discussion and the models are in unusually close agreement, with no rain showing up for either day. Air quality is good, too. Enjoy the bright stretch, but grab the warmer layer for early morning and evening plans, especially tonight.
